coverage_check: before unblinding, simulate percentile-interval coverage for episode means at the realized episode count under normal, t3, skewed and two-point-outlier episode distributions

methods_study.advantage: deletion: random-order mean minus method; insertion: method minus random-order mean; positive favors the method
change_after_calibration: across responses: preferred under Q differs from preferred under N for the same modality and direction
under z-scaling: preferred by z-scaled advantage differs from preferred by advantage

against fixed bars: for deletion, the method with the largest share of calls at or below 0.40 (and at or below 0.5) differs from the preferred method, or a method passes a bar under one response and fails it under the other
through population: preferred on the complete-case population differs from preferred on all available calls
methods_study.complete_case: an episode enters a comparison only when every planned call has defined normalized areas for every ranking in it under both responses; every excluded call and its reason is reported

random.state: exact mean over all subsets at each count (8 groups)

methods_study.count_rule: max1_round (the saved runs' rule); the round rule is a sensitivity analysis

decision_rule.beats_heuristics: its mean advantage exceeds that of every fixed order, with the interval for best minus best fixed order reported
decision_rule.preferred: highest episode-mean calibrated advantage among the methods (not the fixed orders), per modality, response and direction
decision_rule.probability_best: share of bootstrap draws (same resampled episodes for every method) in which it has the highest mean
decision_rule.unique: the Bonferroni-adjusted interval (alpha 0.05/4 over the four response-direction cells of a modality) for best minus second-best excludes zero

methods_study.descriptive: every other modality, direction, response, method and control, with 95% intervals and no multiplicity claim
methods_study.metric: normalized_auc on the realized-fraction axis; the nominal-axis area is reported beside it
methods_study.note: Subtracting a common random-order reference cannot reorder methods under one response; those four routes are the only ways calibration can change the preferred method, and each is reported.
methods_study.unit: reset episode; calls weighted equally within an episode, episodes equally
methods_study.z_scaled: advantage divided by the standard deviation over random orders (exact over all 40320 orders for state)

arms.A0: historical bf16 replica, m=64 (and m=128 on the Month 8 PegInsertionSide and PickSingleYCB strata)
arms.A1: bf16 forward, fp32 accumulation, 513-node nested grid: T_m and E_m for m = 1..512, M_n for n = 1..256
arms.A2: fp32 forward on the fp32 probe context, same rules
arms.A4: adaptive vector Gauss-Kronrod 21-point, L1 error estimate, rtol 1e-4, at most 49 intervals (fp32), subset

criteria_reported_with_denominators.source: Month 8 provisional engineering criteria; study-specific, not general thresholds

expectations: N: endpoint-inclusive rules carry an O(1/m) term from the removable gradient jump at the input
outcomes: coordinate relative L1, max abs and signed-sum difference
group Spearman, top-1, top-5% overlap, deleted-set Jaccard at each schedule count
normalized-AUC change of each arm's ranking against the reference ranking, Q and N, deletion and insertion, all scored by the common bf16 forward
nonfinite counts by arm, stage, node and sign (NaN, +inf, -inf)

populations.month8: all 21 available Month 8 contexts (16 RDT-170M, 5 RDT-1B)
populations.new: the P contexts of the first 6 episodes (fp32 arms) and all P contexts (bf16 arms)

reference.bf16_function: A1 T512 is the finite-budget comparator for the bf16 function, not truth
reference.rule: A4 where it converges; qualified when A4, GL128 and A2 T512 agree within relative L1 1e-3 pairwise; the largest pairwise disagreement is the resolution floor

numerics_study.statement: whatever the outcome, the numerical accuracy of the saved headline rankings stays unverified: their contexts were not preserved, so these runs characterize the procedure, not those rankings

responses.RMS: reported in units only; its normalized area equals N's

scope: Analysis of the NHSJS-R1 GPU runs: the methods study (Must Fix 5), the numerics comparison (Must Fix 6) and the end-to-end record (Must Fix 2). Written before any production attribution or response exists.
